Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1-11 a-b)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #11 a-b) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.

a.
NC-1623-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions & remodeling to the single family residence located at 977 Paseo La Cresta. Lot 18, Tract 31329. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: BPS, Inc./Robert Mull
2601 Airport Dr. #310
Torrance, CA 90505
Owner: Frederick & Sherry Davidowitz
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Criley absent) with standard conditions.
b.
NC-1620/G-1615/SC-138/M-1255-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, Sports Court & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence, sports court & walls exceeding the allowable height located at 1201 Granvia Altamira. Lot 1, Block 4, Tract 7538 & portion of Lot E, Tract 8652. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Jeffrey Dahl
1102 Main St.
Huntington Beach, CA 92648
Owner: Sahil Sharma
Action: Approved the applications (3-1 in favor, Chang dissenting, Criley absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Payment to the tree bank shall be submitted for the removal of the street tree in the City right-of-way in the location where the driveway is proposed. New street trees shall be planted at the direction of the Urban Forester; 2) The maximum height of the sports court walls and fences shall be a maximum of 10 ft. when measured from the tennis court surface; 3) A 5-foot wide public sewer line runs on the property alongside and parallel to the southerly property line. The developer shall determine the actual location, alignment and condition of the sewer mainline, confirmed by video surveillance and report. Easements shall be shown on the plan. If the sewer is found to not lie within the existing easement, a new easement shall be dedicated and existing easement vacated; legal description and easement deeds shall be prepared by a licensed land surveyor with costs and applicable fees paid by the applicant. No object, whether a permanent structure, pool, or a temporary structure, or any object which is difficult to remove are allowed within sewer easements. Any grading within the sewer easement shall be approved prior to issuance of any building permits; 4) A geotechnical report shall be provided that supports that proposed construction of walls/pool will not adversely surcharge or otherwise impact the existing sewer line; 5) The project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply with the Cityâ€™s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C; 6) Drainage shall follow natural drainage pattern; 7) Damaged curb and gutter, including by existing trees or proposed construction, shall be removed and replaced per the City Engineer; and 8) The chimney adjacent to the living room shall be reduced in width by 2 ft.
Staff Report

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the City of Laguna Beach for the exchange of City of Palos Verdes Estates Rule 20A credits to the City of Laguna Beach, at a discounted rate of $0.55 totaling $495,000 in unencumbered General Fund revenue, and submit a credit transfer authorization letter to Southern California Edison (SCE).
